# Orbital Breach

> Orbital Breach is a free zero-gravity browser multiplayer shooter with a Three.js + TypeScript client and a Colyseus/Node.js server, where two teams score by freezing every opponent or breaching the enemy portal, and the first team to five points wins.

## Play

- [Play Orbital Breach](https://orbital-breach.vercel.app/): browser game with solo bot matches and online multiplayer.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DotanVG/Orbital-Breach): client, server, and shared gameplay code.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/DotanVG/Orbital-Breach/blob/main/README.md): gameplay, controls, playlists, and local setup.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/DotanVG/Orbital-Breach/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): client, shared rules, multiplayer server, and deployment.
- [Testing guide](https://github.com/DotanVG/Orbital-Breach/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md): test commands and manual smoke checklist.

## Controls and modes

- Desktop: mouse to look, WASD to walk in breach rooms, E to grab or release rails, Space to jump, hold Space while grabbing to charge a launch, and left mouse button to fire.
- V toggles first-person/third-person view; Tab shows the scoreboard; Esc opens the session menu; H shows help.
- Touch controls include movement, look, grab, jump/launch, fire, and camera toggle.
- Solo and online team sizes: 1v1, 2v2, 5v5, 10v10, and 20v20. Tutorial mode uses an empty arena without bots.

## Tech overview

- Client: Three.js, TypeScript, and Vite.
- Multiplayer server: Node.js, Express, and Colyseus over WebSocket, with authoritative match state.
- Shared code: match rules, constants, arena generation, and multiplayer types.
